explanation: The April 10 commit changed only the leaderboard scores. It supplied no new evaluation trace and did not update the training report. Both historical score sets are retained; the cause of the difference is not established.
historical_evaluation_limitations: Training used unsorted file IDs while analysis sorted them; seed 0 alone cannot recover a matching validation set.
Training validation dropped the final incomplete batch.
Training Dice excluded class index 0, while analysis included it.
Historical analysis averaged only classes with ground-truth support, potentially ignoring false positives for absent ground-truth classes.
